name: Design2Code
intro: Design2Code评估多模态模型把真实网页截图转换为HTML/CSS的能力。论文从C4验证集的127.9k个网页出发，经自动过滤去重到14k，再由两位作者从7k个抽样候选中整理出484个主测试网页；另有80个独立GitHub来源的HARD网页。生成页面经浏览器渲染后，以元素级与高层视觉指标评估，并用人类成对偏好验证。
org: Stanford University, Georgia Institute of Technology
build_method: C4真实网页抓取与CSS内联, 自动过滤去重, 依赖隔离, 两位作者人工筛选, 独立HARD集
metric: Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, CLIP, Human Pairwise Preference
modality: 图像, 文本, 代码
eval_feature: 真实网页, 多模态截图到代码, 浏览器渲染比较, 人工偏好校验
build_method_en: C4 Real-page Scraping and CSS Inlining, Automatic Filtering and Deduplication, Dependency Isolation, Two-author Manual Curation, Separate HARD Set
eval_feature_en: Real Webpages, Multimodal Screenshot-to-code, Browser-rendered Comparison, Human-preference Validation
intro_en: Design2Code evaluates multimodal models that convert real webpage screenshots into HTML/CSS. The paper starts from 127.9k C4-validation webpages, automatically filters and deduplicates them to 14k, and has two authors curate 484 main test pages from a 7k sample; a separate HARD set contains 80 GitHub-sourced pages. Generated pages are browser-rendered, scored with element-level and high-level visual metrics, and validated against human pairwise preferences.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.03163v3 §2.1, §2.3, §4.2-§4.5, Appendix B, and Appendix F, plus official repository snapshot 7a575e4. C4 validation links become 127.9k inlined pages; pages over 100k GPT-2 tokens, image-only/text-only pages, and duplicates are removed to 14k. Two authors align on 200 pages at 75%, then split a random 7k for standalone, safety, format, and diversity review, yielding 484 pages. HARD separately comes from allowed-license GitHub Pages repositories and contains 80 pages; the final HARD selection from the crawled pool is not disclosed. Automatic Block-Match/Text/Position/Color/CLIP scores are the benchmark outputs. The separate human study uses 100 examples, five annotators, majority vote, and 435 Win/Lose pairs split 50/50 to fit a logistic model with 79.9% test accuracy.
